items.heading: Nearly Every University with International
items.text: Nearly every university with international students offers its own scholarships, ranging from partial tuition waivers to full-ride packages for top applicants. These are decided by the admissions or financial aid office of the specific school, usually as part of, or shortly after, your regular admission review.

items.heading: Awarded Largely on Academic Record,
items.text: Awarded largely on academic record, test scores, and sometimes a supplementary essay or interview.

items.heading: Often Auto
items.text: Often auto-considered from your regular admission application, with no separate form required.

items.heading: Amount and Coverage Vary Widely,
items.text: Amount and coverage vary widely, from a modest tuition discount to a full-ride package at a small number of top applicants per batch.

items.heading: Best Target
items.text: Best target: universities where your profile sits above their typical admitted range, not only your reach schools.
